query: For one pilot, what are the core functions versus adaptable forms, what explicit adaptation decision rules will we allow, and what fidelity/adaptation tracking template will we use?

response.query: For one pilot, what are the core functions versus adaptable forms, what explicit adaptation decision rules will we allow, and what fidelity/adaptation tracking template will we use?
response.answer: Core functions must remain intact; adaptable forms allow context-specific adjustments. Use the Adaptations of Forms Tracking Matrix for fidelity tracking. Maintain fidelity to core functions for effective outcomes.

results.title: Functions & Forms
results.content: Adaptations of Forms Tracking Matrix. A fillable PDF to track fidelity to function and adaptations to forms over time (e.g., implementation coaching sessions)

results.title: The core functions and forms paradigm throughout EPIS
results.content: These implementation determinants can directly inform the collaborative development and/or selection of appropriate forms (a.k.a., adaptations) that match a local context and population while still seeking to maintain sufficient fidelity to the interventions’ core functions to promote effective outcomes. Edmunds’ et al.'s (2022) Components & Rationales for Effectiveness (CORE) Fidelity Method for identifying key components of EBPs offers highly relevant guidance for augmenting our approach by providing systematic guidelines for gathering and synthesizing information to develop a CORE model that outlines the essential intervention components to fulfilling each function and the possible forms by which this might occur (14). Citation: Terrana A, Viglione C, Rhee K, Rabin B, Godino J, Aarons GA, Chapman J, Melendrez B, Holguin M, Osorio L, Gidwani P, Juarez Nunez C, Firestein G and Hekler E (2024) The core functions and forms paradigm throughout EPIS: designing and implementing an evidence-based practice with function fidelity.
